https://pixelsprout.dev/devlog/rocco-v0-6-0/

I have just released a new version at Rocco at a major milestone! The engine now has some key features that were missing, namely:

  1. Positional audio
  2. PBR and shadow maps
  3. Tone mapping
  4. Basic gamepad support
  5. Basic engine and window configuration
  6. Documentation and guides

Check out the guide here to get started. Feel free to give me a shout if you spot any issues or discrepancies.

Or you can check out this Kula world remake built with Rocco. https://github.com/Pixelsprout/kula
Oh I also forgot to mention that the engine supports a debug bridge. So your agents can also play your game!
